title: SQL Server and Oracle capture don't follow an added column

found.by: zerobus-debezium-test planning rounds 4-5 for SOURCE=mssql, oracle

symptom: Not run yet: rounds 4 and 5 (add, drop, retype a column) are off for these sources
cause: SQL Server's capture instance keeps its column list (a new column needs a new capture instance); Oracle's online catalog mines with the current dictionary only
effect: A schema change on the source may not reach bronze until capture is reconfigured
fix: To test: a second capture instance (SQL Server), the redo-log catalog (Oracle)
